ko.title: 1.5%에서 5.0%로: 애틀랜타 연준의 추적 지표는 성장 반등을 가리키는데, 왜 경제는 여전히 약하게 느껴질까?

segments.src: Two very different pictures of the U.S.
segments.tr: 미국 경제에 대한 두 가지 매우 다른 모습이

segments.src: economy are circulating at the same time.
segments.tr: 동시에 유통되고 있습니다.

segments.src: In one, a widely watched Atlanta Fed estimate points to third-quarter growth near 5.0%, a sharp step up from 1.5% in the second quarter.
segments.tr: 한쪽에서는 널리 주목받는 애틀랜타 연준의 추정치가 3분기 성장률을 2분기 1.5%에서 급격히 상승한 5.0% 근처로 가리키고 있습니다.

segments.src: In the other, households report low confidence and inflation remains stubborn, with the July reading on the Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) price index at 3.7%.
segments.tr: 다른 한쪽에서는 가계가 낮은 신뢰도를 보고하고 있으며, 7월 개인소비지출(PCE) 물가 지수가 3.7%를 기록하는 등 인플레이션이 여전히 완강합니다.

segments.src: Both can be true.
segments.tr: 둘 다 사실일 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Understanding why starts with what the growth number actually measures, what is driving it, and what it leaves out.
segments.tr: 그 이유를 이해하려면 성장률 수치가 실제로 무엇을 측정하는지, 무엇이 이를 견인하는지, 그리고 무엇을 배제하고 있는지부터 시작해야 합니다.

segments.src: ## What the GDPNow Tracker Is (and Isn't)
segments.tr: ## GDPNow 추적 지표란 무엇인가 (그리고 무엇이 아닌가)

segments.src: GDPNow is a running estimate published by the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta.
segments.tr: GDPNow는 애틀랜타 연방준비은행이 발표하는 실시간 추정치입니다.

segments.src: It takes incoming economic data, such as retail sales, manufacturing, housing, trade, and inventories, and translates it into a real-time estimate of what quarterly GDP growth might look like once the official figures are released.
segments.tr: 소매 판매, 제조업, 주택, 무역, 재고와 같은 유입되는 경제 데이터를 가져와 공식 수치가 발표되었을 때 분기별 GDP 성장률이 어떻게 보일지에 대한 실시간 추정치로 변환합니다.

segments.src: A few points are worth keeping in mind:
segments.tr: 몇 가지 점을 염두에 둘 필요가 있습니다:

segments.src: - **It is a model, not an official statistic.** The government's official GDP numbers come from the Bureau of Economic Analysis (BEA). GDPNow is not a forecast from Federal Reserve policymakers.
segments.tr: - **이것은 모델이지 공식 통계가 아닙니다.** 정부의 공식 GDP 수치는 경제분석국(BEA)에서 나옵니다. GDPNow는 연방준비제도 정책 입안자들의 전망치가 아닙니다.

segments.src: - **It moves.** Each new data release can shift the estimate, sometimes significantly, especially when a quarter is not yet complete.
segments.tr: - **변동합니다.** 새로운 데이터가 발표될 때마다 추정치가 바뀔 수 있으며, 특히 분기가 아직 끝나지 않았을 때는 그 폭이 상당히 클 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **It can miss.** Nowcasts have at times landed well above or below the first official reading, so a headline near 5.0% is best read as a signal of momentum rather than a final answer.
segments.tr: - **오차가 있을 수 있습니다.** 나우캐스트(Nowcast)는 때때로 첫 공식 발표치보다 훨씬 높거나 낮게 나타난 적이 있으므로, 5.0% 근처의 헤드라인 수치는 최종 답안이라기보다는 모멘텀의 신호로 읽는 것이 가장 좋습니다.

segments.src: ## The Numbers Behind the Rebound
segments.tr: ## 반등의 이면에 있는 수치들

segments.src: The estimate for the third quarter is driven largely by two components:
segments.tr: 3분기 추정치는 주로 두 가지 구성 요소에 의해 주도됩니다:

segments.src: | Component | Reported figure | Why it matters |
segments.tr: | 구성 요소 | 보고된 수치 | 중요한 이유 |

segments.src: | Overall real GDP growth (Q3 tracking estimate) | Near 5.0% | Up from 1.5% in Q2 |
segments.tr: | 전체 실질 GDP 성장률 (3분기 추적 추정치) | 5.0% 근처 | 2분기 1.5%에서 상승 |

segments.src: | Private investment | Up 18.7% | Business spending on equipment, software, structures, and inventories can swing sharply from quarter to quarter |
segments.tr: | 민간 투자 | 18.7% 증가 | 장비, 소프트웨어, 구조물 및 재고에 대한 기업 지출은 분기마다 급격하게 변동할 수 있음 |

segments.src: | Consumer spending | Up 4.2% | Household spending makes up roughly two-thirds of the economy, so even modest changes carry weight |
segments.tr: | 소비자 지출 | 4.2% 증가 | 가계 지출은 경제의 약 3분의 2를 차지하므로 작은 변화도 큰 영향을 미침 |

segments.src: Growth rates for a single quarter are conventionally quoted at an annualized pace, which is why the figures can look larger than everyday intuition suggests.
segments.tr: 단일 분기의 성장률은 관례적으로 연율로 표시되기 때문에 수치가 일상적인 직관보다 크게 보일 수 있습니다.

segments.src: A jump in investment of this size also tends to be concentrated in a few categories rather than spread evenly across the economy.
segments.tr: 이 정도 규모의 투자 급증은 경제 전반에 고르게 퍼지기보다는 몇몇 범주에 집중되는 경향이 있습니다.

segments.src: ## Why It Still Feels Weak
segments.tr: ## 왜 여전히 약하게 느껴지는가

segments.src: If output is accelerating, why does sentiment sag?
segments.tr: 생산량이 가속화되고 있다면 왜 심리는 위축될까요?

segments.src: Economists point to several overlapping explanations.
segments.tr: 경제학자들은 몇 가지 중첩된 설명을 제시합니다.

segments.src: Prices are still the main complaint.** Growth statistics are adjusted for inflation, but household budgets are not experienced as a rate of change.
segments.tr: 물가가 여전히 주된 불만 사항입니다.** 성장 통계는 인플레이션을 반영하여 조정되지만, 가계 예산은 변화율로 체감되지 않습니다.

segments.src: They are experienced as a level.
segments.tr: 사람들은 이를 수준으로 체감합니다.

segments.src: Even if inflation cools, groceries, rent, insurance, and utilities cost more than they did a few years ago.
segments.tr: 인플레이션이 둔화되더라도 식료품, 임대료, 보험, 공과금은 몇 년 전보다 더 비쌉니다.

segments.src: With the July PCE reading at 3.7%, prices are still rising faster than many households would like, and that shapes how people feel about their finances regardless of what GDP shows.
segments.tr: 7월 PCE 수치가 3.7%인 상황에서 물가는 여전히 많은 가계가 원하는 것보다 빠르게 상승하고 있으며, GDP가 무엇을 보여주든 상관없이 이것이 사람들의 재정 상태에 대한 느낌을 형성합니다.

segments.src: Sentiment surveys measure mood, not just money.** Consumer confidence gauges reflect perceptions about prices, interest rates, job security, and the news cycle.
segments.tr: 심리 조사는 돈뿐만 아니라 기분을 측정합니다.** 소비자 신뢰 지표는 물가, 금리, 고용 안정성, 뉴스 주기에 대한 인식을 반영합니다.

segments.src: Historically, what people say in surveys and what they actually spend have not always moved together.
segments.tr: 역사적으로 사람들이 설문조사에서 말하는 것과 실제로 소비하는 것이 항상 함께 움직이지는 않았습니다.

segments.src: It is possible for people to feel pessimistic and still keep spending.
segments.tr: 사람들이 비관적으로 느끼면서도 계속 소비하는 것은 가능합니다.

segments.src: Aggregate spending can hide uneven experiences.** A 4.2% rise in consumer spending is an average across all households.
segments.tr: 총지출은 불균등한 경험을 가릴 수 있습니다.** 소비자 지출의 4.2% 증가는 모든 가계에 걸친 평균입니다.

segments.src: Research on consumption patterns has often found that a large share of total spending comes from higher-income households, while lower- and middle-income families may feel more pressure from everyday costs.
segments.tr: 소비 패턴에 대한 연구에 따르면 총지출의 큰 부분은 고소득 가계에서 나오며, 저소득 및 중산층 가족은 일상적인 비용으로 인해 더 큰 압박을 느낄 수 있습니다.

segments.src: An investment boom is not the same as a paycheck boom.** Spending on buildings, equipment, and technology adds to GDP right away.
segments.tr: 투자 붐이 곧 임금 붐은 아닙니다.** 건물, 장비, 기술에 대한 지출은 즉시 GDP에 추가됩니다.

segments.src: But it does not automatically translate into higher wages, lower borrowing costs, or cheaper essentials for the average household.
segments.tr: 하지만 이것이 자동으로 평균적인 가계의 임금 상승, 차입 비용 감소, 또는 필수품 가격 하락으로 이어지지는 않습니다.

segments.src: ## The AI Data-Center Question
segments.tr: ## AI 데이터 센터 문제

segments.src: The most debated part of the story is how much of the investment surge is tied to the buildout of artificial-intelligence infrastructure: data-center construction, servers and chips, networking gear, and the power and cooling systems that support them.
segments.tr: 이 이야기에서 가장 논쟁이 되는 부분은 투자 급증의 얼마나 많은 부분이 인공지능 인프라 구축(데이터 센터 건설, 서버 및 칩, 네트워킹 장비, 그리고 이를 지원하는 전력 및 냉각 시스템)과 관련되어 있는지입니다.

segments.src: These outlays are counted as business investment, and when they accelerate, they can lift the headline growth figure noticeably.
segments.tr: 이러한 지출은 기업 투자로 계산되며, 가속화될 때 헤드라인 성장 수치를 눈에 띄게 끌어올릴 수 있습니다.

segments.src: That raises a few questions economists are weighing:
segments.tr: 이는 경제학자들이 고려하고 있는 몇 가지 질문을 제기합니다:

segments.src: - **How much is imported?** Much of the advanced hardware is produced abroad. In GDP accounting, imports are subtracted, so a surge in spending on imported equipment does not add as much to domestic output as the investment figure alone might suggest.
segments.tr: - **얼마나 수입되는가?** 첨단 하드웨어의 상당 부분은 해외에서 생산됩니다. GDP 회계에서 수입은 차감되므로, 수입 장비에 대한 지출 급증은 투자 수치만 볼 때보다 국내 생산에 더 적게 기여합니다.

segments.src: - **How concentrated is it?** If a relatively small number of large companies account for a large share of the spending, changes in their plans could reverse the contribution quickly.
segments.tr: - **얼마나 집중되어 있는가?** 비교적 소수의 대기업이 지출의 큰 부분을 차지한다면, 그들의 계획 변경이 기여도를 빠르게 반전시킬 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **How durable is it?** Investment is inherently lumpy. A strong quarter does not guarantee the next one, and the payoff from these projects, in productivity and profits, will take time to become clear.
segments.tr: - **얼마나 지속 가능한가?** 투자는 본질적으로 불규칙합니다. 한 분기가 좋다고 다음 분기가 보장되는 것은 아니며, 생산성과 이익 측면에서 이러한 프로젝트의 성과가 명확해지려면 시간이 걸릴 것입니다.

segments.src: - **What does it do for everyone else?** Construction, electrical work, and energy demand may benefit locally, but the broader effect on jobs and household income is harder to measure and still being studied.
segments.tr: - **다른 모든 사람에게는 어떤 영향을 미치는가?** 건설, 전기 작업, 에너지 수요는 지역적으로 혜택을 볼 수 있지만, 일자리와 가계 소득에 미치는 광범위한 영향은 측정하기 어렵고 여전히 연구 중입니다.

segments.src: None of this means the expansion is fragile or that the spending is misplaced.
segments.tr: 이 중 어느 것도 확장이 취약하다거나 지출이 잘못되었다는 것을 의미하지는 않습니다.

segments.src: It means the composition of growth matters as much as the headline.
segments.tr: 이는 성장의 구성이 헤드라인만큼 중요하다는 것을 의미합니다.

segments.src: ## What to Watch on Sept. 30
segments.tr: ## 9월 30일에 주목할 점

segments.src: Two data releases due on Sept.
segments.tr: 9월 30일에 예정된 두 가지 데이터 발표가

segments.src: 30 could sharpen the picture:
segments.tr: 상황을 더 명확하게 할 수 있습니다:

segments.src: 1. **The revision to second-quarter GDP.** The 1.5% figure for Q2 is the base against which the third-quarter rebound is being measured. A revision up or down would change how large the swing looks.
segments.tr: 1. **2분기 GDP 수정치.** 2분기 1.5% 수치는 3분기 반등을 측정하는 기준점입니다. 상향 또는 하향 수정은 변동 폭이 얼마나 커 보이는지를 바꿀 것입니다.

segments.src: 2. **August PCE inflation.** The PCE index is the inflation gauge the Federal Reserve tracks most closely. Whether the July pace of 3.7% eases, holds, or picks up will matter for household sentiment and for expectations about interest rates. It is also worth checking whether a given figure is the headline or the "core" measure (which excludes food and energy), and whether it is a monthly or annual change, since they can tell different stories.
segments.tr: 2. **8월 PCE 인플레이션.** PCE 지수는 연방준비제도가 가장 면밀히 추적하는 인플레이션 지표입니다. 7월의 3.7% 속도가 완화될지, 유지될지, 아니면 상승할지는 가계 심리와 금리에 대한 기대치에 중요할 것입니다. 또한 주어진 수치가 헤드라인인지 아니면 (식품과 에너지를 제외한) "근원" 지표인지, 그리고 월간 변화인지 연간 변화인지 확인하는 것도 가치가 있습니다. 왜냐하면 그것들은 서로 다른 이야기를 말해줄 수 있기 때문입니다.

segments.src: The first official estimate of third-quarter GDP will come only after the quarter ends, so the tracker's number will continue to shift as new data arrive.
segments.tr: 3분기 GDP의 첫 공식 추정치는 분기가 끝난 후에야 나오므로, 새로운 데이터가 들어옴에 따라 추적 지표의 수치는 계속 변할 것입니다.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## 결론

segments.src: A strong growth estimate and a gloomy public mood are not necessarily a contradiction.
segments.tr: 강력한 성장 추정치와 우울한 대중 심리는 반드시 모순되는 것은 아닙니다.

segments.src: GDP measures the total value of what the economy produces, while sentiment reflects how people experience prices, borrowing costs, and job prospects in daily life.
segments.tr: GDP는 경제가 생산하는 총 가치를 측정하는 반면, 심리는 사람들이 일상생활에서 물가, 차입 비용, 고용 전망을 어떻게 경험하는지를 반영합니다.

segments.src: When growth leans on business investment, particularly in a single fast-moving area such as AI infrastructure, the gap between the statistics and the lived experience can widen.
segments.tr: 성장이 기업 투자, 특히 AI 인프라와 같은 단일하고 빠르게 움직이는 분야에 의존할 때, 통계와 실제 경험 사이의 격차는 커질 수 있습니다.

segments.src: For readers trying to make sense of the data, a few habits help: look at several indicators rather than one, distinguish between estimates and official releases, and pay attention to what is driving a number rather than only how large it is.
segments.tr: 데이터를 이해하려는 독자들에게는 몇 가지 습관이 도움이 됩니다: 하나가 아닌 여러 지표를 살펴보고, 추정치와 공식 발표치를 구분하며, 수치가 얼마나 큰지뿐만 아니라 무엇이 그 수치를 견인하는지에 주의를 기울이십시오.

segments.src: *This article is for general information only and is not financial, investment, or economic advice.
segments.tr: *이 기사는 일반적인 정보 제공만을 목적으로 하며 재정, 투자 또는 경제적 조언이 아닙니다.

segments.src: Figures cited reflect the Atlanta Fed's GDPNow tracker and related government data as reported at the time of writing and may be revised in later releases.*
segments.tr: 인용된 수치는 작성 시점에 보고된 애틀랜타 연준의 GDPNow 추적 지표 및 관련 정부 데이터를 반영하며, 이후 발표에서 수정될 수 있습니다.*

segments.src: ## What the GDPNow Tracker Is (and Isn't)
segments.tr: ## GDPNow 追踪指标是什么（以及它不是什么）

segments.src: GDPNow is a running estimate published by the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta.
segments.tr: GDPNow 是亚特兰大联邦储备银行发布的一项实时估算指标。

segments.src: It takes incoming economic data, such as retail sales, manufacturing, housing, trade, and inventories, and translates it into a real-time estimate of what quarterly GDP growth might look like once the official figures are released.
segments.tr: 它获取零售销售、制造业、住房、贸易和库存等即时经济数据，并将其转化为对官方数据发布后季度 GDP 增长情况的实时估算。

segments.src: A few points are worth keeping in mind:
segments.tr: 有几点值得注意：

segments.src: - **It is a model, not an official statistic.** The government's official GDP numbers come from the Bureau of Economic Analysis (BEA). GDPNow is not a forecast from Federal Reserve policymakers.
segments.tr: - **它是一个模型，而非官方统计数据。** 政府的官方 GDP 数据来自经济分析局 (BEA)。GDPNow 并非美联储政策制定者的预测。

segments.src: - **It moves.** Each new data release can shift the estimate, sometimes significantly, especially when a quarter is not yet complete.
segments.tr: - **它会变动。** 每一项新数据的发布都可能改变估算值，有时甚至幅度很大，尤其是在季度尚未结束时。

segments.src: - **It can miss.** Nowcasts have at times landed well above or below the first official reading, so a headline near 5.0% is best read as a signal of momentum rather than a final answer.
segments.tr: - **它可能会有偏差。** 实时预测有时会远高于或低于首次官方读数，因此接近 5.0% 的标题数据最好被解读为增长势头的信号，而非最终定论。

segments.src: ## The Numbers Behind the Rebound
segments.tr: ## 反弹背后的数字

segments.src: The estimate for the third quarter is driven largely by two components:
segments.tr: 第三季度的估算值主要由两个部分驱动：

segments.src: | Component | Reported figure | Why it matters |
segments.tr: | 组成部分 | 报告数据 | 重要性 |

segments.src: | Overall real GDP growth (Q3 tracking estimate) | Near 5.0% | Up from 1.5% in Q2 |
segments.tr: | 整体实际 GDP 增长（第三季度追踪估算） | 接近 5.0% | 高于第二季度的 1.5% |

segments.src: | Private investment | Up 18.7% | Business spending on equipment, software, structures, and inventories can swing sharply from quarter to quarter |
segments.tr: | 私人投资 | 上升 18.7% | 企业在设备、软件、建筑和库存方面的支出可能会在季度间剧烈波动 |

segments.src: | Consumer spending | Up 4.2% | Household spending makes up roughly two-thirds of the economy, so even modest changes carry weight |
segments.tr: | 消费者支出 | 上升 4.2% | 家庭支出约占经济的三分之二，因此即使是微小的变化也会产生影响 |

segments.src: Growth rates for a single quarter are conventionally quoted at an annualized pace, which is why the figures can look larger than everyday intuition suggests.
segments.tr: 单季度的增长率通常按年化速度计算，这就是为什么这些数字看起来比日常直觉所预期的要大。

segments.src: A jump in investment of this size also tends to be concentrated in a few categories rather than spread evenly across the economy.
segments.tr: 如此规模的投资跳升往往集中在少数几个类别，而不是在整个经济中均匀分布。

segments.src: ## Why It Still Feels Weak
segments.tr: ## 为何感觉依然疲软

segments.src: If output is accelerating, why does sentiment sag?
segments.tr: 如果产出在加速，为什么情绪却在低落？

segments.src: Economists point to several overlapping explanations.
segments.tr: 经济学家指出了几个相互重叠的解释。

segments.src: Prices are still the main complaint.** Growth statistics are adjusted for inflation, but household budgets are not experienced as a rate of change.
segments.tr: 价格仍然是主要抱怨点。** 增长统计数据经过了通胀调整，但家庭预算并非以变化率来感受。

segments.src: They are experienced as a level.
segments.tr: 他们感受的是绝对水平。

segments.src: Even if inflation cools, groceries, rent, insurance, and utilities cost more than they did a few years ago.
segments.tr: 即使通胀降温，食品杂货、租金、保险和公用事业的成本仍比几年前要高。

segments.src: With the July PCE reading at 3.7%, prices are still rising faster than many households would like, and that shapes how people feel about their finances regardless of what GDP shows.
segments.tr: 随着 7 月份 PCE 读数达到 3.7%，价格上涨速度仍快于许多家庭的预期，无论 GDP 显示什么，这都影响了人们对财务状况的感受。

segments.src: Sentiment surveys measure mood, not just money.** Consumer confidence gauges reflect perceptions about prices, interest rates, job security, and the news cycle.
segments.tr: 情绪调查衡量的是心情，而不仅仅是金钱。** 消费者信心指标反映了人们对价格、利率、工作保障和新闻周期的看法。

segments.src: Historically, what people say in surveys and what they actually spend have not always moved together.
segments.tr: 从历史上看，人们在调查中所说的与他们实际的支出并不总是同步的。

segments.src: It is possible for people to feel pessimistic and still keep spending.
segments.tr: 人们感到悲观但仍保持支出是有可能的。

segments.src: Aggregate spending can hide uneven experiences.** A 4.2% rise in consumer spending is an average across all households.
segments.tr: 总支出可能会掩盖不均衡的体验。** 消费者支出增长 4.2% 是所有家庭的平均值。

segments.src: Research on consumption patterns has often found that a large share of total spending comes from higher-income households, while lower- and middle-income families may feel more pressure from everyday costs.
segments.tr: 关于消费模式的研究经常发现，总支出的大部分来自高收入家庭，而中低收入家庭可能感受到更大的日常成本压力。

segments.src: An investment boom is not the same as a paycheck boom.** Spending on buildings, equipment, and technology adds to GDP right away.
segments.tr: 投资繁荣并不等同于工资繁荣。** 在建筑、设备和技术上的支出会立即增加 GDP。

segments.src: But it does not automatically translate into higher wages, lower borrowing costs, or cheaper essentials for the average household.
segments.tr: 但这并不会自动转化为普通家庭更高的工资、更低的借贷成本或更便宜的生活必需品。

segments.src: ## The AI Data-Center Question
segments.tr: ## AI 数据中心的问题

segments.src: The most debated part of the story is how much of the investment surge is tied to the buildout of artificial-intelligence infrastructure: data-center construction, servers and chips, networking gear, and the power and cooling systems that support them.
segments.tr: 这一叙事中最具争议的部分是，投资激增中有多少与人工智能基础设施的建设有关：数据中心建设、服务器和芯片、网络设备，以及支持它们的电力和冷却系统。

segments.src: These outlays are counted as business investment, and when they accelerate, they can lift the headline growth figure noticeably.
segments.tr: 这些支出被计入商业投资，当它们加速时，可以显著提升总体增长数字。

segments.src: That raises a few questions economists are weighing:
segments.tr: 这引发了经济学家正在权衡的几个问题：

segments.src: - **How much is imported?** Much of the advanced hardware is produced abroad. In GDP accounting, imports are subtracted, so a surge in spending on imported equipment does not add as much to domestic output as the investment figure alone might suggest.
segments.tr: - **进口占比多少？** 许多先进硬件是在国外生产的。在 GDP 核算中，进口会被扣除，因此进口设备支出的激增对国内产出的贡献并不像投资数字本身所暗示的那样大。

segments.src: - **How concentrated is it?** If a relatively small number of large companies account for a large share of the spending, changes in their plans could reverse the contribution quickly.
segments.tr: - **集中度如何？** 如果相对少数的大公司占据了支出的很大份额，那么它们计划的改变可能会迅速逆转这一贡献。

segments.src: - **How durable is it?** Investment is inherently lumpy. A strong quarter does not guarantee the next one, and the payoff from these projects, in productivity and profits, will take time to become clear.
segments.tr: - **持久性如何？** 投资本质上是不均衡的。一个强劲的季度并不能保证下一个季度也是如此，而且这些项目在生产力和利润方面的回报需要时间才能显现。

segments.src: - **What does it do for everyone else?** Construction, electrical work, and energy demand may benefit locally, but the broader effect on jobs and household income is harder to measure and still being studied.
segments.tr: - **这对其他人有什么影响？** 建筑、电气工程和能源需求可能会在当地受益，但对就业和家庭收入的更广泛影响更难衡量，目前仍在研究中。

segments.src: None of this means the expansion is fragile or that the spending is misplaced.
segments.tr: 这并不意味着扩张是脆弱的，也不意味着支出被误置了。

segments.src: It means the composition of growth matters as much as the headline.
segments.tr: 这意味着增长的构成与总体数字同样重要。

segments.src: ## What to Watch on Sept. 30
segments.tr: ## 9 月 30 日值得关注的内容

segments.src: Two data releases due on Sept.
segments.tr: 9 月 30 日发布的两个数据可能会使情况更加清晰：

segments.src: 30 could sharpen the picture:
segments.tr: 30 日发布的两个数据可能会使情况更加清晰：

segments.src: 1. **The revision to second-quarter GDP.** The 1.5% figure for Q2 is the base against which the third-quarter rebound is being measured. A revision up or down would change how large the swing looks.
segments.tr: 1. **第二季度 GDP 的修正值。** 第二季度 1.5% 的数字是衡量第三季度反弹的基准。向上或向下的修正都会改变波动幅度看起来的大小。

segments.src: 2. **August PCE inflation.** The PCE index is the inflation gauge the Federal Reserve tracks most closely. Whether the July pace of 3.7% eases, holds, or picks up will matter for household sentiment and for expectations about interest rates. It is also worth checking whether a given figure is the headline or the "core" measure (which excludes food and energy), and whether it is a monthly or annual change, since they can tell different stories.
segments.tr: 2. **8 月份 PCE 通胀。** PCE 指数是美联储最密切关注的通胀指标。7 月份 3.7% 的增速是放缓、持平还是回升，将对家庭情绪和利率预期产生影响。同样值得检查的是，给出的数字是总体指标还是“核心”指标（剔除食品和能源），以及它是月度还是年度变化，因为它们可能讲述不同的故事。

segments.src: The first official estimate of third-quarter GDP will come only after the quarter ends, so the tracker's number will continue to shift as new data arrive.
segments.tr: 第三季度 GDP 的首次官方估算只有在季度结束后才会发布，因此随着新数据的到来，追踪指标的数字将继续变动。

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## 结论

segments.src: A strong growth estimate and a gloomy public mood are not necessarily a contradiction.
segments.tr: 强劲的增长估算与低迷的公众情绪并不一定矛盾。

segments.src: GDP measures the total value of what the economy produces, while sentiment reflects how people experience prices, borrowing costs, and job prospects in daily life.
segments.tr: GDP 衡量的是经济生产的总价值，而情绪反映的是人们在日常生活中对价格、借贷成本和就业前景的体验。

segments.src: When growth leans on business investment, particularly in a single fast-moving area such as AI infrastructure, the gap between the statistics and the lived experience can widen.
segments.tr: 当增长依赖于商业投资，特别是在人工智能基础设施等单一快速发展的领域时，统计数据与生活体验之间的差距可能会扩大。

segments.src: For readers trying to make sense of the data, a few habits help: look at several indicators rather than one, distinguish between estimates and official releases, and pay attention to what is driving a number rather than only how large it is.
segments.tr: 对于试图理解这些数据的读者来说，养成几个习惯会有所帮助：查看多个指标而不是一个，区分估算值和官方发布的数据，并关注推动数字增长的因素，而不仅仅是数字的大小。

segments.src: *This article is for general information only and is not financial, investment, or economic advice.
segments.tr: *本文仅供一般参考，不构成财务、投资或经济建议。

segments.src: Figures cited reflect the Atlanta Fed's GDPNow tracker and related government data as reported at the time of writing and may be revised in later releases.*

segments.src: Two very different pictures of the U.S.
segments.tr: अमेरिकी अर्थव्यवस्था की दो बहुत अलग तस्वीरें

segments.src: ## What the GDPNow Tracker Is (and Isn't)
segments.tr: ## GDPNow ट्रैकर क्या है (और क्या नहीं है)

segments.src: GDPNow is a running estimate published by the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta.
segments.tr: GDPNow अटलांटा के फेडरल रिजर्व बैंक द्वारा प्रकाशित एक चालू अनुमान है।

segments.src: It takes incoming economic data, such as retail sales, manufacturing, housing, trade, and inventories, and translates it into a real-time estimate of what quarterly GDP growth might look like once the official figures are released.
segments.tr: यह आने वाले आर्थिक डेटा, जैसे खुदरा बिक्री, विनिर्माण, आवास, व्यापार और इन्वेंट्री को लेता है, और इसे वास्तविक समय के अनुमान में अनुवादित करता है कि आधिकारिक आंकड़े जारी होने के बाद तिमाही जीडीपी विकास कैसा दिख सकता है।

segments.src: A few points are worth keeping in mind:
segments.tr: कुछ बिंदुओं को ध्यान में रखना उचित है:

segments.src: - **It is a model, not an official statistic.** The government's official GDP numbers come from the Bureau of Economic Analysis (BEA). GDPNow is not a forecast from Federal Reserve policymakers.
segments.tr: - **यह एक मॉडल है, आधिकारिक सांख्यिकी नहीं।** सरकार की आधिकारिक जीडीपी संख्या आर्थिक विश्लेषण ब्यूरो (BEA) से आती है। GDPNow फेडरल रिजर्व नीति निर्माताओं का पूर्वानुमान नहीं है।

segments.src: - **It moves.** Each new data release can shift the estimate, sometimes significantly, especially when a quarter is not yet complete.
segments.tr: - **यह बदलता रहता है।** प्रत्येक नया डेटा रिलीज़ अनुमान को बदल सकता है, कभी-कभी काफी हद तक, विशेष रूप से जब एक तिमाही अभी पूरी नहीं हुई हो।

segments.src: - **It can miss.** Nowcasts have at times landed well above or below the first official reading, so a headline near 5.0% is best read as a signal of momentum rather than a final answer.
segments.tr: - **यह चूक सकता है।** नाउकास्ट कभी-कभी पहली आधिकारिक रीडिंग से काफी ऊपर या नीचे रहे हैं, इसलिए 5.0% के करीब की हेडलाइन को अंतिम उत्तर के बजाय गति के संकेत के रूप में पढ़ना सबसे अच्छा है।

segments.src: ## The Numbers Behind the Rebound
segments.tr: ## उछाल के पीछे के आंकड़े

segments.src: The estimate for the third quarter is driven largely by two components:
segments.tr: तीसरी तिमाही के लिए अनुमान काफी हद तक दो घटकों द्वारा संचालित है:

segments.src: | Component | Reported figure | Why it matters |
segments.tr: | घटक | रिपोर्ट किया गया आंकड़ा | यह क्यों मायने रखता है |

segments.src: | Overall real GDP growth (Q3 tracking estimate) | Near 5.0% | Up from 1.5% in Q2 |
segments.tr: | कुल वास्तविक जीडीपी विकास (Q3 ट्रैकिंग अनुमान) | 5.0% के करीब | Q2 में 1.5% से ऊपर |

segments.src: | Private investment | Up 18.7% | Business spending on equipment, software, structures, and inventories can swing sharply from quarter to quarter |
segments.tr: | निजी निवेश | 18.7% ऊपर | उपकरण, सॉफ्टवेयर, संरचनाओं और इन्वेंट्री पर व्यावसायिक खर्च तिमाही-दर-तिमाही तेजी से बदल सकता है |

segments.src: | Consumer spending | Up 4.2% | Household spending makes up roughly two-thirds of the economy, so even modest changes carry weight |
segments.tr: | उपभोक्ता खर्च | 4.2% ऊपर | घरेलू खर्च अर्थव्यवस्था का लगभग दो-तिहाई हिस्सा बनाता है, इसलिए मामूली बदलाव भी मायने रखते हैं |

segments.src: Growth rates for a single quarter are conventionally quoted at an annualized pace, which is why the figures can look larger than everyday intuition suggests.
segments.tr: एकल तिमाही के लिए विकास दर को पारंपरिक रूप से वार्षिक गति पर उद्धृत किया जाता है, यही कारण है कि आंकड़े दैनिक अंतर्ज्ञान के सुझाव से बड़े दिख सकते हैं।

segments.src: A jump in investment of this size also tends to be concentrated in a few categories rather than spread evenly across the economy.
segments.tr: इस आकार के निवेश में उछाल भी अर्थव्यवस्था में समान रूप से फैलने के बजाय कुछ श्रेणियों में केंद्रित होता है।

segments.src: ## Why It Still Feels Weak
segments.tr: ## यह अभी भी कमजोर क्यों महसूस होता है

segments.src: If output is accelerating, why does sentiment sag?
segments.tr: यदि उत्पादन बढ़ रहा है, तो भावना क्यों गिर रही है?

segments.src: Economists point to several overlapping explanations.
segments.tr: अर्थशास्त्री कई ओवरलैपिंग स्पष्टीकरणों की ओर इशारा करते हैं।

segments.src: Prices are still the main complaint.** Growth statistics are adjusted for inflation, but household budgets are not experienced as a rate of change.
segments.tr: कीमतें अभी भी मुख्य शिकायत हैं।** विकास के आंकड़ों को मुद्रास्फीति के लिए समायोजित किया जाता है, लेकिन घरेलू बजट का अनुभव परिवर्तन की दर के रूप में नहीं किया जाता है।

segments.src: They are experienced as a level.
segments.tr: वे एक स्तर के रूप में अनुभव किए जाते हैं।

segments.src: Even if inflation cools, groceries, rent, insurance, and utilities cost more than they did a few years ago.
segments.tr: भले ही मुद्रास्फीति कम हो जाए, किराने का सामान, किराया, बीमा और उपयोगिताओं की लागत कुछ साल पहले की तुलना में अधिक है।

segments.src: With the July PCE reading at 3.7%, prices are still rising faster than many households would like, and that shapes how people feel about their finances regardless of what GDP shows.
segments.tr: जुलाई PCE रीडिंग 3.7% पर होने के साथ, कीमतें अभी भी उतनी तेजी से बढ़ रही हैं जितनी कई परिवार नहीं चाहते, और यह आकार देता है कि लोग जीडीपी के बावजूद अपने वित्त के बारे में कैसा महसूस करते हैं।

segments.src: Sentiment surveys measure mood, not just money.** Consumer confidence gauges reflect perceptions about prices, interest rates, job security, and the news cycle.
segments.tr: भावना सर्वेक्षण मूड को मापते हैं, सिर्फ पैसे को नहीं।** उपभोक्ता विश्वास गेज कीमतों, ब्याज दरों, नौकरी की सुरक्षा और समाचार चक्र के बारे में धारणाओं को दर्शाते हैं।

segments.src: Historically, what people say in surveys and what they actually spend have not always moved together.
segments.tr: ऐतिहासिक रूप से, लोग सर्वेक्षणों में क्या कहते हैं और वे वास्तव में क्या खर्च करते हैं, वे हमेशा एक साथ नहीं चले हैं।

segments.src: It is possible for people to feel pessimistic and still keep spending.
segments.tr: लोगों के लिए निराशावादी महसूस करना और फिर भी खर्च करना जारी रखना संभव है।

segments.src: Aggregate spending can hide uneven experiences.** A 4.2% rise in consumer spending is an average across all households.
segments.tr: कुल खर्च असमान अनुभवों को छिपा सकता है।** उपभोक्ता खर्च में 4.2% की वृद्धि सभी परिवारों का औसत है।

segments.src: Research on consumption patterns has often found that a large share of total spending comes from higher-income households, while lower- and middle-income families may feel more pressure from everyday costs.
segments.tr: उपभोग पैटर्न पर शोध ने अक्सर पाया है कि कुल खर्च का एक बड़ा हिस्सा उच्च-आय वाले परिवारों से आता है, जबकि निम्न- और मध्यम-आय वाले परिवार रोजमर्रा की लागतों से अधिक दबाव महसूस कर सकते हैं।

segments.src: An investment boom is not the same as a paycheck boom.** Spending on buildings, equipment, and technology adds to GDP right away.
segments.tr: निवेश उछाल वेतन उछाल के समान नहीं है।** इमारतों, उपकरणों और प्रौद्योगिकी पर खर्च तुरंत जीडीपी में जुड़ जाता है।

segments.src: But it does not automatically translate into higher wages, lower borrowing costs, or cheaper essentials for the average household.
segments.tr: लेकिन यह स्वचालित रूप से औसत परिवार के लिए उच्च मजदूरी, कम उधार लेने की लागत, या सस्ती आवश्यक वस्तुओं में अनुवादित नहीं होता है।

segments.src: ## The AI Data-Center Question
segments.tr: ## एआई डेटा-सेंटर का सवाल

segments.src: The most debated part of the story is how much of the investment surge is tied to the buildout of artificial-intelligence infrastructure: data-center construction, servers and chips, networking gear, and the power and cooling systems that support them.
segments.tr: कहानी का सबसे चर्चित हिस्सा यह है कि निवेश का कितना उछाल आर्टिफिशियल-इंटेलिजेंस इंफ्रास्ट्रक्चर के निर्माण से जुड़ा है: डेटा-सेंटर निर्माण, सर्वर और चिप्स, नेटवर्किंग गियर, और उन्हें समर्थन देने वाली बिजली और शीतलन प्रणाली।

segments.src: These outlays are counted as business investment, and when they accelerate, they can lift the headline growth figure noticeably.
segments.tr: इन खर्चों को व्यावसायिक निवेश के रूप में गिना जाता है, और जब वे तेज होते हैं, तो वे हेडलाइन विकास के आंकड़े को काफी बढ़ा सकते हैं।

segments.src: That raises a few questions economists are weighing:
segments.tr: यह कुछ ऐसे सवाल उठाता है जिन पर अर्थशास्त्री विचार कर रहे हैं:

segments.src: - **How much is imported?** Much of the advanced hardware is produced abroad. In GDP accounting, imports are subtracted, so a surge in spending on imported equipment does not add as much to domestic output as the investment figure alone might suggest.
segments.tr: - **कितना आयात किया जाता है?** अधिकांश उन्नत हार्डवेयर विदेशों में उत्पादित होते हैं। जीडीपी लेखांकन में, आयात को घटाया जाता है, इसलिए आयातित उपकरणों पर खर्च में उछाल घरेलू उत्पादन में उतना नहीं जुड़ता जितना कि निवेश का आंकड़ा अकेले सुझाव दे सकता है।

segments.src: - **How concentrated is it?** If a relatively small number of large companies account for a large share of the spending, changes in their plans could reverse the contribution quickly.
segments.tr: - **यह कितना केंद्रित है?** यदि अपेक्षाकृत कम संख्या में बड़ी कंपनियां खर्च का एक बड़ा हिस्सा बनाती हैं, तो उनकी योजनाओं में बदलाव योगदान को जल्दी से उलट सकता है।

segments.src: - **How durable is it?** Investment is inherently lumpy. A strong quarter does not guarantee the next one, and the payoff from these projects, in productivity and profits, will take time to become clear.
segments.tr: - **यह कितना टिकाऊ है?** निवेश स्वाभाविक रूप से असमान है। एक मजबूत तिमाही अगले की गारंटी नहीं देती है, और उत्पादकता और मुनाफे में इन परियोजनाओं से मिलने वाले लाभ को स्पष्ट होने में समय लगेगा।

segments.src: - **What does it do for everyone else?** Construction, electrical work, and energy demand may benefit locally, but the broader effect on jobs and household income is harder to measure and still being studied.
segments.tr: - **यह बाकी सभी के लिए क्या करता है?** निर्माण, विद्युत कार्य और ऊर्जा की मांग स्थानीय रूप से लाभान्वित हो सकती है, लेकिन नौकरियों और घरेलू आय पर व्यापक प्रभाव को मापना कठिन है और अभी भी अध्ययन किया जा रहा है।

segments.src: None of this means the expansion is fragile or that the spending is misplaced.
segments.tr: इसका मतलब यह नहीं है कि विस्तार नाजुक है या खर्च गलत जगह पर है।

segments.src: It means the composition of growth matters as much as the headline.
segments.tr: इसका मतलब है कि विकास की संरचना हेडलाइन जितनी ही मायने रखती है।

segments.src: ## What to Watch on Sept. 30
segments.tr: ## 30 सितंबर को क्या देखना है

segments.src: Two data releases due on Sept.
segments.tr: 30 सितंबर को दो डेटा रिलीज़ होने वाले हैं

segments.src: 30 could sharpen the picture:
segments.tr: जो तस्वीर को स्पष्ट कर सकते हैं:

segments.src: 1. **The revision to second-quarter GDP.** The 1.5% figure for Q2 is the base against which the third-quarter rebound is being measured. A revision up or down would change how large the swing looks.
segments.tr: 1. **दूसरी तिमाही की जीडीपी का संशोधन।** Q2 के लिए 1.5% का आंकड़ा वह आधार है जिसके खिलाफ तीसरी तिमाही के उछाल को मापा जा रहा है। ऊपर या नीचे का संशोधन यह बदल देगा कि उछाल कितना बड़ा दिखता है।

segments.src: 2. **August PCE inflation.** The PCE index is the inflation gauge the Federal Reserve tracks most closely. Whether the July pace of 3.7% eases, holds, or picks up will matter for household sentiment and for expectations about interest rates. It is also worth checking whether a given figure is the headline or the "core" measure (which excludes food and energy), and whether it is a monthly or annual change, since they can tell different stories.
segments.tr: 2. **अगस्त PCE मुद्रास्फीति।** PCE सूचकांक वह मुद्रास्फीति गेज है जिसे फेडरल रिजर्व सबसे बारीकी से ट्रैक करता है। जुलाई की 3.7% की गति कम होती है, स्थिर रहती है, या बढ़ती है, यह घरेलू भावना और ब्याज दरों के बारे में उम्मीदों के लिए मायने रखेगा। यह जांचना भी उचित है कि क्या कोई दिया गया आंकड़ा हेडलाइन है या "कोर" उपाय (जो भोजन और ऊर्जा को बाहर करता है), और क्या यह मासिक या वार्षिक परिवर्तन है, क्योंकि वे अलग-अलग कहानियां बता सकते हैं।

segments.src: The first official estimate of third-quarter GDP will come only after the quarter ends, so the tracker's number will continue to shift as new data arrive.
segments.tr: तीसरी तिमाही की जीडीपी का पहला आधिकारिक अनुमान तिमाही समाप्त होने के बाद ही आएगा, इसलिए ट्रैकर की संख्या नए डेटा आने पर बदलती रहेगी।

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## निष्कर्ष

segments.src: A strong growth estimate and a gloomy public mood are not necessarily a contradiction.
segments.tr: एक मजबूत विकास अनुमान और उदास सार्वजनिक मूड जरूरी नहीं कि विरोधाभास हो।

segments.src: GDP measures the total value of what the economy produces, while sentiment reflects how people experience prices, borrowing costs, and job prospects in daily life.
segments.tr: जीडीपी मापता है कि अर्थव्यवस्था क्या उत्पादन करती है, जबकि भावना दर्शाती है कि लोग दैनिक जीवन में कीमतों, उधार लेने की लागत और नौकरी की संभावनाओं का अनुभव कैसे करते हैं।

segments.src: When growth leans on business investment, particularly in a single fast-moving area such as AI infrastructure, the gap between the statistics and the lived experience can widen.
segments.tr: जब विकास व्यावसायिक निवेश पर निर्भर करता है, विशेष रूप से एआई इंफ्रास्ट्रक्चर जैसे एकल तेजी से बढ़ते क्षेत्र में, तो आंकड़ों और जीवित अनुभव के बीच का अंतर बढ़ सकता है।

segments.src: For readers trying to make sense of the data, a few habits help: look at several indicators rather than one, distinguish between estimates and official releases, and pay attention to what is driving a number rather than only how large it is.
segments.tr: डेटा को समझने की कोशिश कर रहे पाठकों के लिए, कुछ आदतें मदद करती हैं: एक के बजाय कई संकेतकों को देखें, अनुमानों और आधिकारिक रिलीज़ के बीच अंतर करें, और इस बात पर ध्यान दें कि संख्या को क्या प्रेरित कर रहा है, न कि केवल यह कि वह कितनी बड़ी है।

es.title: Del 1.5% al 5.0%: El rastreador de la Fed de Atlanta señala un repunte del crecimiento, entonces, ¿por qué la economía todavía se siente tan débil?

segments.src: Two very different pictures of the U.S.
segments.tr: Dos imágenes muy diferentes de la

segments.src: economy are circulating at the same time.
segments.tr: economía estadounidense circulan al mismo tiempo.

segments.src: In one, a widely watched Atlanta Fed estimate points to third-quarter growth near 5.0%, a sharp step up from 1.5% in the second quarter.
segments.tr: En una, una estimación de la Fed de Atlanta, ampliamente observada, apunta a un crecimiento del tercer trimestre cercano al 5.0%, un fuerte aumento desde el 1.5% del segundo trimestre.

segments.src: In the other, households report low confidence and inflation remains stubborn, with the July reading on the Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) price index at 3.7%.
segments.tr: En la otra, los hogares reportan una baja confianza y la inflación sigue siendo persistente, con la lectura de julio del índice de precios de Gastos de Consumo Personal (PCE) en 3.7%.

segments.src: Both can be true.
segments.tr: Ambas pueden ser ciertas.

segments.src: Understanding why starts with what the growth number actually measures, what is driving it, and what it leaves out.
segments.tr: Entender por qué comienza con lo que realmente mide la cifra de crecimiento, qué la está impulsando y qué deja fuera.

segments.src: ## What the GDPNow Tracker Is (and Isn't)
segments.tr: ## Qué es (y qué no es) el rastreador GDPNow

segments.src: GDPNow is a running estimate published by the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta.
segments.tr: GDPNow es una estimación continua publicada por el Banco de la Reserva Federal de Atlanta.

segments.src: It takes incoming economic data, such as retail sales, manufacturing, housing, trade, and inventories, and translates it into a real-time estimate of what quarterly GDP growth might look like once the official figures are released.
segments.tr: Toma los datos económicos entrantes, como las ventas minoristas, la manufactura, la vivienda, el comercio y los inventarios, y los traduce en una estimación en tiempo real de cómo podría verse el crecimiento del PIB trimestral una vez que se publiquen las cifras oficiales.

segments.src: A few points are worth keeping in mind:
segments.tr: Vale la pena tener en cuenta algunos puntos:

segments.src: - **It is a model, not an official statistic.** The government's official GDP numbers come from the Bureau of Economic Analysis (BEA). GDPNow is not a forecast from Federal Reserve policymakers.
segments.tr: - **Es un modelo, no una estadística oficial.** Las cifras oficiales del PIB del gobierno provienen de la Oficina de Análisis Económico (BEA). GDPNow no es un pronóstico de los responsables de la política monetaria de la Reserva Federal.

segments.src: - **It moves.** Each new data release can shift the estimate, sometimes significantly, especially when a quarter is not yet complete.
segments.tr: - **Se mueve.** Cada nueva publicación de datos puede cambiar la estimación, a veces significativamente, especialmente cuando un trimestre aún no está completo.

segments.src: - **It can miss.** Nowcasts have at times landed well above or below the first official reading, so a headline near 5.0% is best read as a signal of momentum rather than a final answer.
segments.tr: - **Puede fallar.** Los "nowcasts" (pronósticos actuales) a veces han aterrizado muy por encima o por debajo de la primera lectura oficial, por lo que un titular cercano al 5.0% se interpreta mejor como una señal de impulso que como una respuesta definitiva.

segments.src: ## The Numbers Behind the Rebound
segments.tr: ## Las cifras detrás del repunte

segments.src: The estimate for the third quarter is driven largely by two components:
segments.tr: La estimación para el tercer trimestre está impulsada en gran medida por dos componentes:

segments.src: | Component | Reported figure | Why it matters |
segments.tr: | Componente | Cifra reportada | Por qué importa |

segments.src: | Overall real GDP growth (Q3 tracking estimate) | Near 5.0% | Up from 1.5% in Q2 |
segments.tr: | Crecimiento real general del PIB (estimación de seguimiento del T3) | Cerca del 5.0% | Arriba del 1.5% en el T2 |

segments.src: | Private investment | Up 18.7% | Business spending on equipment, software, structures, and inventories can swing sharply from quarter to quarter |
segments.tr: | Inversión privada | Arriba 18.7% | El gasto empresarial en equipos, software, estructuras e inventarios puede oscilar bruscamente de un trimestre a otro |

segments.src: | Consumer spending | Up 4.2% | Household spending makes up roughly two-thirds of the economy, so even modest changes carry weight |
segments.tr: | Gasto del consumidor | Arriba 4.2% | El gasto de los hogares representa aproximadamente dos tercios de la economía, por lo que incluso cambios modestos tienen peso |

segments.src: Growth rates for a single quarter are conventionally quoted at an annualized pace, which is why the figures can look larger than everyday intuition suggests.
segments.tr: Las tasas de crecimiento para un solo trimestre se citan convencionalmente a un ritmo anualizado, razón por la cual las cifras pueden parecer más grandes de lo que sugiere la intuición cotidiana.

segments.src: A jump in investment of this size also tends to be concentrated in a few categories rather than spread evenly across the economy.
segments.tr: Un salto en la inversión de este tamaño también tiende a concentrarse en unas pocas categorías en lugar de distribuirse uniformemente en toda la economía.

segments.src: ## Why It Still Feels Weak
segments.tr: ## Por qué todavía se siente débil

segments.src: If output is accelerating, why does sentiment sag?
segments.tr: Si la producción se está acelerando, ¿por qué el sentimiento decae?

segments.src: Economists point to several overlapping explanations.
segments.tr: Los economistas señalan varias explicaciones superpuestas.

segments.src: Prices are still the main complaint.** Growth statistics are adjusted for inflation, but household budgets are not experienced as a rate of change.
segments.tr: Los precios siguen siendo la principal queja.** Las estadísticas de crecimiento se ajustan por inflación, pero los presupuestos de los hogares no se experimentan como una tasa de cambio.

segments.src: They are experienced as a level.
segments.tr: Se experimentan como un nivel.

segments.src: Even if inflation cools, groceries, rent, insurance, and utilities cost more than they did a few years ago.
segments.tr: Incluso si la inflación se enfría, los comestibles, el alquiler, los seguros y los servicios públicos cuestan más de lo que costaban hace unos años.

segments.src: With the July PCE reading at 3.7%, prices are still rising faster than many households would like, and that shapes how people feel about their finances regardless of what GDP shows.
segments.tr: Con la lectura del PCE de julio en 3.7%, los precios siguen subiendo más rápido de lo que a muchos hogares les gustaría, y eso moldea cómo se siente la gente sobre sus finanzas independientemente de lo que muestre el PIB.

segments.src: Sentiment surveys measure mood, not just money.** Consumer confidence gauges reflect perceptions about prices, interest rates, job security, and the news cycle.
segments.tr: Las encuestas de sentimiento miden el estado de ánimo, no solo el dinero.** Los indicadores de confianza del consumidor reflejan percepciones sobre los precios, las tasas de interés, la seguridad laboral y el ciclo de noticias.

segments.src: Historically, what people say in surveys and what they actually spend have not always moved together.
segments.tr: Históricamente, lo que la gente dice en las encuestas y lo que realmente gasta no siempre se han movido juntos.

segments.src: It is possible for people to feel pessimistic and still keep spending.
segments.tr: Es posible que las personas se sientan pesimistas y aun así sigan gastando.

segments.src: Aggregate spending can hide uneven experiences.** A 4.2% rise in consumer spending is an average across all households.
segments.tr: El gasto agregado puede ocultar experiencias desiguales.** Un aumento del 4.2% en el gasto del consumidor es un promedio en todos los hogares.

segments.src: Research on consumption patterns has often found that a large share of total spending comes from higher-income households, while lower- and middle-income families may feel more pressure from everyday costs.
segments.tr: La investigación sobre los patrones de consumo a menudo ha encontrado que una gran parte del gasto total proviene de hogares de mayores ingresos, mientras que las familias de ingresos bajos y medios pueden sentir más presión por los costos diarios.

segments.src: An investment boom is not the same as a paycheck boom.** Spending on buildings, equipment, and technology adds to GDP right away.
segments.tr: Un auge de inversión no es lo mismo que un auge de salarios.** El gasto en edificios, equipos y tecnología se suma al PIB de inmediato.

segments.src: But it does not automatically translate into higher wages, lower borrowing costs, or cheaper essentials for the average household.
segments.tr: Pero no se traduce automáticamente en salarios más altos, costos de endeudamiento más bajos o productos básicos más baratos para el hogar promedio.

segments.src: ## The AI Data-Center Question
segments.tr: ## La pregunta sobre los centros de datos de IA

segments.src: The most debated part of the story is how much of the investment surge is tied to the buildout of artificial-intelligence infrastructure: data-center construction, servers and chips, networking gear, and the power and cooling systems that support them.
segments.tr: La parte más debatida de la historia es cuánto del aumento de la inversión está vinculado a la construcción de infraestructura de inteligencia artificial: construcción de centros de datos, servidores y chips, equipos de red, y los sistemas de energía y refrigeración que los soportan.

segments.src: These outlays are counted as business investment, and when they accelerate, they can lift the headline growth figure noticeably.
segments.tr: Estos desembolsos se cuentan como inversión empresarial, y cuando se aceleran, pueden elevar la cifra de crecimiento principal notablemente.

segments.src: That raises a few questions economists are weighing:
segments.tr: Eso plantea algunas preguntas que los economistas están sopesando:

segments.src: - **How much is imported?** Much of the advanced hardware is produced abroad. In GDP accounting, imports are subtracted, so a surge in spending on imported equipment does not add as much to domestic output as the investment figure alone might suggest.
segments.tr: - **¿Cuánto es importado?** Gran parte del hardware avanzado se produce en el extranjero. En la contabilidad del PIB, las importaciones se restan, por lo que un aumento en el gasto en equipos importados no añade tanto a la producción nacional como la cifra de inversión por sí sola podría sugerir.

segments.src: - **How concentrated is it?** If a relatively small number of large companies account for a large share of the spending, changes in their plans could reverse the contribution quickly.
segments.tr: - **¿Qué tan concentrado está?** Si un número relativamente pequeño de grandes empresas representa una gran parte del gasto, los cambios en sus planes podrían revertir la contribución rápidamente.

segments.src: - **How durable is it?** Investment is inherently lumpy. A strong quarter does not guarantee the next one, and the payoff from these projects, in productivity and profits, will take time to become clear.
segments.tr: - **¿Qué tan duradero es?** La inversión es inherentemente irregular. Un trimestre fuerte no garantiza el siguiente, y la recompensa de estos proyectos, en productividad y ganancias, tomará tiempo para quedar clara.

segments.src: - **What does it do for everyone else?** Construction, electrical work, and energy demand may benefit locally, but the broader effect on jobs and household income is harder to measure and still being studied.
segments.tr: - **¿Qué hace por todos los demás?** La construcción, el trabajo eléctrico y la demanda de energía pueden beneficiarse localmente, pero el efecto más amplio en los empleos y los ingresos de los hogares es más difícil de medir y todavía se está estudiando.

segments.src: None of this means the expansion is fragile or that the spending is misplaced.
segments.tr: Nada de esto significa que la expansión sea frágil o que el gasto esté fuera de lugar.

segments.src: It means the composition of growth matters as much as the headline.
segments.tr: Significa que la composición del crecimiento importa tanto como el titular.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## La conclusión

segments.src: A strong growth estimate and a gloomy public mood are not necessarily a contradiction.
segments.tr: Una estimación de crecimiento fuerte y un estado de ánimo público sombrío no son necesariamente una contradicción.

segments.src: GDP measures the total value of what the economy produces, while sentiment reflects how people experience prices, borrowing costs, and job prospects in daily life.
segments.tr: El PIB mide el valor total de lo que produce la economía, mientras que el sentimiento refleja cómo las personas experimentan los precios, los costos de endeudamiento y las perspectivas laborales en la vida diaria.

segments.src: When growth leans on business investment, particularly in a single fast-moving area such as AI infrastructure, the gap between the statistics and the lived experience can widen.
segments.tr: Cuando el crecimiento se apoya en la inversión empresarial, particularmente en un área única de rápido movimiento como la infraestructura de IA, la brecha entre las estadísticas y la experiencia vivida puede ampliarse.

segments.src: For readers trying to make sense of the data, a few habits help: look at several indicators rather than one, distinguish between estimates and official releases, and pay attention to what is driving a number rather than only how large it is.
segments.tr: Para los lectores que intentan dar sentido a los datos, algunos hábitos ayudan: observar varios indicadores en lugar de uno, distinguir entre estimaciones y publicaciones oficiales, y prestar atención a lo que está impulsando un número en lugar de solo qué tan grande es.

segments.src: ## What the GDPNow Tracker Is (and Isn't)
segments.tr: ## ما هو مؤشر GDPNow (وما لا يُمثله)

segments.src: GDPNow is a running estimate published by the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta.
segments.tr: GDPNow هو تقدير جاري ينشره بنك الاحتياطي الفيدرالي في أتلانتا.

segments.src: It takes incoming economic data, such as retail sales, manufacturing, housing, trade, and inventories, and translates it into a real-time estimate of what quarterly GDP growth might look like once the official figures are released.
segments.tr: وهو يأخذ البيانات الاقتصادية الواردة، مثل مبيعات التجزئة، والتصنيع، والإسكان، والتجارة، والمخزونات، ويترجمها إلى تقدير في الوقت الفعلي لشكل نمو الناتج المحلي الإجمالي الربعي بمجرد صدور الأرقام الرسمية.

segments.src: A few points are worth keeping in mind:
segments.tr: هناك عدة نقاط تجدر مراعاتها:

segments.src: - **It is a model, not an official statistic.** The government's official GDP numbers come from the Bureau of Economic Analysis (BEA). GDPNow is not a forecast from Federal Reserve policymakers.
segments.tr: - **إنه نموذج وليس إحصاءً رسمياً.** تأتي أرقام الناتج المحلي الإجمالي الرسمية للحكومة من مكتب التحليل الاقتصادى (BEA). إن GDPNow ليس توقعاً من صانعي السياسات في بنك الاحتياطي الفيدرالي.

segments.src: - **It moves.** Each new data release can shift the estimate, sometimes significantly, especially when a quarter is not yet complete.
segments.tr: - **إنه يتغير.** يمكن لكل إصدار جديد للبيانات أن يغير التقدير، وأحياناً بشكل كبير، خاصة عندما لا يكون الربع قد اكتمل بعد.

segments.src: - **It can miss.** Nowcasts have at times landed well above or below the first official reading, so a headline near 5.0% is best read as a signal of momentum rather than a final answer.
segments.tr: - **يمكن أن يخطئ.** لقد هبطت التوقعات الفورية في بعض الأحيان أعلى بكثير أو أقل بكثير من القراءة الرسمية الأولى، لذا يُفضل قراءة عنوان رئيسي يقارب 5.0% كإشارة على الزخم بدلاً من كونها إجابة نهائية.

segments.src: ## Why It Still Feels Weak
segments.tr: ## لماذا لا يزال يبدو ضعيفاً

segments.src: If output is accelerating, why does sentiment sag?
segments.tr: إذا كان الإنتاج يتسارع، فلماذا يتراجع الشعور العام؟

segments.src: Economists point to several overlapping explanations.
segments.tr: يشير الاقتصاديون إلى عدة تفسيرات متداخلة.

segments.src: Prices are still the main complaint.** Growth statistics are adjusted for inflation, but household budgets are not experienced as a rate of change.
segments.tr: الأسعار لا تزال الشكوى الرئيسية.** تتم تعديل إحصاءات النمو وفقاً للتضخم، ولكن ميزانيات الأسر لا يتم اختبارها كمعدل التغيير.

segments.src: They are experienced as a level.
segments.tr: إنها تختبر كمستوى.

segments.src: Even if inflation cools, groceries, rent, insurance, and utilities cost more than they did a few years ago.
segments.tr: حتى لو برد التضخم، فإن البقالة، والإيجار، والتأمين، والمرافق تكلف أكثر مما كانت عليه قبل بضع سنوات.

segments.src: With the July PCE reading at 3.7%, prices are still rising faster than many households would like, and that shapes how people feel about their finances regardless of what GDP shows.
segments.tr: مع قراءة مؤشر PCE لشهر يوليو عند 3.7%، لا تزال الأسعار ترتفع بشكل أسرع مما قد ترغب فيه العديد من الأسر، وهذا يشكل شعور الناس تجاه ماليتهم بغض النظر عما يظهره الناتج المحلي الإجمالي.

segments.src: Sentiment surveys measure mood, not just money.** Consumer confidence gauges reflect perceptions about prices, interest rates, job security, and the news cycle.
segments.tr: تستقي استطلاعات الشعور المزاج وليس المال فقط.** تعكس مقاييس ثقة المستهلك التصورات حول الأسعار، وأسعار الفائدة، والأمان الوظيفي، ودورة الأخبار.

segments.src: Historically, what people say in surveys and what they actually spend have not always moved together.
segments.tr: تاريخياً، لم تتحرك التصريحات في الاستطلاعات وما ينفقه الناس فعلياً معاً دائماً.

segments.src: It is possible for people to feel pessimistic and still keep spending.
segments.tr: من الممكن أن يشعر الناس بالتشاؤم والاستمرار في الإنفاق.

segments.src: Aggregate spending can hide uneven experiences.** A 4.2% rise in consumer spending is an average across all households.
segments.tr: يمكن أن يخفي الإنفاق الإجمالي التجارب غير المتساوية.** إن ارتفاع إنفاق المستهلكين بنسبة 4.2% هو متوسط لجميع الأسر.

segments.src: Research on consumption patterns has often found that a large share of total spending comes from higher-income households, while lower- and middle-income families may feel more pressure from everyday costs.
segments.tr: غالباً ما وجد البحث في أنماط الاستهلاك أن نسبة كبيرة من إجمالي الإنفاق تأتي من الأسر ذات الدخل المرتفع، بينما قد تشعر العائلات ذات الدخل المنخفض والمتوسط بضغط أكبر من التكاليف اليومية.

segments.src: An investment boom is not the same as a paycheck boom.** Spending on buildings, equipment, and technology adds to GDP right away.
segments.tr: طفرة الاستثمار ليست كطفرة رواتب.** يضاف الإنفاق على المباني والمعدات والتكنولوجيا إلى الناتج المحلي الإجمالي على الفور.

segments.src: But it does not automatically translate into higher wages, lower borrowing costs, or cheaper essentials for the average household.
segments.tr: ولكنه لا يترجم تلقائياً إلى أجور أعلى، أو تكاليف اقتراض أقل، أو أساسيات أرخص لمتوسط الأسر.

fr.title: 1,5 % à 5,0 % : l'indicateur de la Fed d'Atlanta signale un rebond de la croissance, alors pourquoi l'économie semble-t-elle toujours si faible ?

segments.src: Two very different pictures of the U.S.
segments.tr: Deux images très différentes de l'économie

segments.src: economy are circulating at the same time.
segments.tr: américaine circulent en même temps.

segments.src: In one, a widely watched Atlanta Fed estimate points to third-quarter growth near 5.0%, a sharp step up from 1.5% in the second quarter.
segments.tr: Dans l'une, une estimation très suivie de la Fed d'Atlanta indique une croissance du troisième trimestre proche de 5,0 %, soit une forte hausse par rapport aux 1,5 % du deuxième trimestre.

segments.src: In the other, households report low confidence and inflation remains stubborn, with the July reading on the Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) price index at 3.7%.
segments.tr: Dans l'autre, les ménages signalent une faible confiance et l'inflation reste tenace, la lecture de juillet de l'indice des prix des dépenses de consommation personnelle (PCE) s'établissant à 3,7 %.

segments.src: Both can be true.
segments.tr: Les deux peuvent être vrais.

segments.src: Understanding why starts with what the growth number actually measures, what is driving it, and what it leaves out.
segments.tr: Comprendre pourquoi commence par ce que le chiffre de la croissance mesure réellement, ce qui le stimule et ce qu'il laisse de côté.

segments.src: ## What the GDPNow Tracker Is (and Isn't)
segments.tr: ## Qu'est-ce que l'indicateur GDPNow (et qu'est-ce qu'il n'est pas) ?

segments.src: GDPNow is a running estimate published by the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta.
segments.tr: GDPNow est une estimation continue publiée par la Federal Reserve Bank d'Atlanta.

segments.src: It takes incoming economic data, such as retail sales, manufacturing, housing, trade, and inventories, and translates it into a real-time estimate of what quarterly GDP growth might look like once the official figures are released.
segments.tr: Il prend les données économiques entrantes, telles que les ventes au détail, la fabrication, le logement, le commerce et les stocks, et les traduit en une estimation en temps réel de ce à quoi la croissance du PIB trimestriel pourrait ressembler une fois les chiffres officiels publiés.

segments.src: A few points are worth keeping in mind:
segments.tr: Quelques points méritent d'être gardés à l'esprit :

segments.src: - **It is a model, not an official statistic.** The government's official GDP numbers come from the Bureau of Economic Analysis (BEA). GDPNow is not a forecast from Federal Reserve policymakers.
segments.tr: - **Il s'agit d'un modèle, et non d'une statistique officielle.** Les chiffres officiels du PIB du gouvernement proviennent du Bureau of Economic Analysis (BEA). GDPNow n'est pas une prévision des décideurs de la Réserve fédérale.

segments.src: - **It moves.** Each new data release can shift the estimate, sometimes significantly, especially when a quarter is not yet complete.
segments.tr: - **Il bouge.** Chaque nouvelle publication de données peut modifier l'estimation, parfois de manière significative, en particulier lorsqu'un trimestre n'est pas encore achevé.

segments.src: - **It can miss.** Nowcasts have at times landed well above or below the first official reading, so a headline near 5.0% is best read as a signal of momentum rather than a final answer.
segments.tr: - **Il peut se tromper.** Les prévisions instantanées ont parfois atterri bien au-dessus ou en dessous de la première lecture officielle, il vaut donc mieux lire un titre proche de 5,0 % comme un signal de dynamique plutôt que comme une réponse définitive.

segments.src: ## The Numbers Behind the Rebound
segments.tr: ## Les chiffres derrière le rebond

segments.src: The estimate for the third quarter is driven largely by two components:
segments.tr: L'estimation pour le troisième trimestre est principalement motivée par deux composantes :

segments.src: | Component | Reported figure | Why it matters |
segments.tr: | Composante | Chiffre déclaré | Pourquoi c'est important |

segments.src: | Overall real GDP growth (Q3 tracking estimate) | Near 5.0% | Up from 1.5% in Q2 |
segments.tr: | Croissance globale du PIB réel (estimation de suivi du T3) | Proche de 5,0 % | En hausse par rapport à 1,5 % au T2 |

segments.src: | Private investment | Up 18.7% | Business spending on equipment, software, structures, and inventories can swing sharply from quarter to quarter |
segments.tr: | Investissement privé | En hausse de 18,7 % | Les dépenses des entreprises en équipements, logiciels, structures et stocks peuvent osciller fortement d'un trimestre à l'autre |

segments.src: | Consumer spending | Up 4.2% | Household spending makes up roughly two-thirds of the economy, so even modest changes carry weight |
segments.tr: | Dépenses de consommation | En hausse de 4,2 % | Les dépenses des ménages représentent environ les deux tiers de l'économie, de sorte que même des changements modestes ont du poids |

segments.src: Growth rates for a single quarter are conventionally quoted at an annualized pace, which is why the figures can look larger than everyday intuition suggests.
segments.tr: Les taux de croissance pour un seul trimestre sont classiquement exprimés à un rythme annualisé, c'est pourquoi les chiffres peuvent sembler plus importants que ne le suggère l'intuition quotidienne.

segments.src: A jump in investment of this size also tends to be concentrated in a few categories rather than spread evenly across the economy.
segments.tr: Un saut dans l'investissement de cette taille a également tendance à être concentré dans quelques catégories plutôt que réparti uniformément dans l'économie.

segments.src: ## Why It Still Feels Weak
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi cela semble toujours aussi faible

segments.src: If output is accelerating, why does sentiment sag?
segments.tr: Si la production s'accélère, pourquoi le moral baisse-t-il ?

segments.src: Economists point to several overlapping explanations.
segments.tr: Les économistes soulignent plusieurs explications qui se recoupent.

segments.src: Prices are still the main complaint.** Growth statistics are adjusted for inflation, but household budgets are not experienced as a rate of change.
segments.tr: Les prix restent la principale plainte.** Les statistiques de croissance sont ajustées pour l'inflation, mais les budgets des ménages ne sont pas vécus comme un taux de changement.

segments.src: They are experienced as a level.
segments.tr: Ils sont vécus comme un niveau.

segments.src: Even if inflation cools, groceries, rent, insurance, and utilities cost more than they did a few years ago.
segments.tr: Même si l'inflation se tasse, l'épicerie, le loyer, l'assurance et les services publics coûtent plus cher qu'il y a quelques années.

segments.src: With the July PCE reading at 3.7%, prices are still rising faster than many households would like, and that shapes how people feel about their finances regardless of what GDP shows.
segments.tr: Avec la lecture du PCE de juillet à 3,7 %, les prix augmentent toujours plus vite que beaucoup de ménages ne le souhaiteraient, et cela façonne la façon dont les gens perçoivent leurs finances, peu importe ce que montre le PIB.

segments.src: Sentiment surveys measure mood, not just money.** Consumer confidence gauges reflect perceptions about prices, interest rates, job security, and the news cycle.
segments.tr: Les enquêtes de moral mesurent l'humeur, pas seulement l'argent.** Les indicateurs de confiance des consommateurs reflètent les perceptions concernant les prix, les taux d'intérêt, la sécurité de l'emploi et le cycle de l'actualité.

segments.src: Historically, what people say in surveys and what they actually spend have not always moved together.
segments.tr: Historiquement, ce que les gens disent dans les sondages et ce qu'ils dépensent réellement n'ont pas toujours évolué ensemble.

segments.src: It is possible for people to feel pessimistic and still keep spending.
segments.tr: Il est possible pour les gens de se sentir pessimistes et de continuer à dépenser.

segments.src: Aggregate spending can hide uneven experiences.** A 4.2% rise in consumer spending is an average across all households.
segments.tr: Les dépenses agrégées peuvent masquer des expériences inégales.** Une hausse de 4,2 % des dépenses de consommation est une moyenne pour tous les ménages.

segments.src: Research on consumption patterns has often found that a large share of total spending comes from higher-income households, while lower- and middle-income families may feel more pressure from everyday costs.
segments.tr: La recherche sur les habitudes de consommation a souvent constaté qu'une grande part des dépenses totales provient des ménages à revenus plus élevés, tandis que les familles à revenus faibles et moyens peuvent ressentir davantage de pression de la part des coûts quotidiens.

segments.src: An investment boom is not the same as a paycheck boom.** Spending on buildings, equipment, and technology adds to GDP right away.
segments.tr: Un boom de l'investissement n'est pas la même chose qu'un boom des salaires.** Les dépenses en bâtiments, équipements et technologies s'ajoutent immédiatement au PIB.

segments.src: But it does not automatically translate into higher wages, lower borrowing costs, or cheaper essentials for the average household.
segments.tr: Mais cela ne se traduit pas automatiquement par des salaires plus élevés, des coûts d'emprunt plus bas ou des produits essentiels moins chers pour le ménage moyen.

segments.src: ## The AI Data-Center Question
segments.tr: ## La question des centres de données d'IA

segments.src: The most debated part of the story is how much of the investment surge is tied to the buildout of artificial-intelligence infrastructure: data-center construction, servers and chips, networking gear, and the power and cooling systems that support them.
segments.tr: La partie la plus débattue de l'histoire est de savoir quelle part de la poussée des investissements est liée au développement de l'infrastructure d'intelligence artificielle : la construction de centres de données, les serveurs et puces, les équipements de réseau, ainsi que les systèmes d'alimentation et de refroidissement qui les soutiennent.

segments.src: These outlays are counted as business investment, and when they accelerate, they can lift the headline growth figure noticeably.
segments.tr: Ces dépenses sont comptabilisées comme des investissements des entreprises, et lorsqu'elles s'accélèrent, elles peuvent augmenter sensiblement le chiffre de croissance global.

segments.src: That raises a few questions economists are weighing:
segments.tr: Cela soulève quelques questions que les économistes pèsent :

segments.src: - **How much is imported?** Much of the advanced hardware is produced abroad. In GDP accounting, imports are subtracted, so a surge in spending on imported equipment does not add as much to domestic output as the investment figure alone might suggest.
segments.tr: - **Quelle quantité est importée ?** Une grande partie du matériel de pointe est produite à l'étranger. Dans la comptabilité du PIB, les importations sont soustraites, de sorte qu'une poussée des dépenses en équipements importés n'ajoute pas autant à la production intérieure que le seul chiffre de l'investissement pourrait le suggérer.

segments.src: - **How concentrated is it?** If a relatively small number of large companies account for a large share of the spending, changes in their plans could reverse the contribution quickly.
segments.tr: - **À quel point est-ce concentré ?** Si un nombre relativement restreint de grandes entreprises représente une grande partie des dépenses, les changements dans leurs plans pourraient inverser rapidement la contribution.

segments.src: - **How durable is it?** Investment is inherently lumpy. A strong quarter does not guarantee the next one, and the payoff from these projects, in productivity and profits, will take time to become clear.
segments.tr: - **À quel point est-ce durable ?** L'investissement est par nature irrégulier. Un trimestre fort ne garantit pas le suivant, et le rendement de ces projets, en termes de productivité et de profits, prendra du temps à devenir clair.

segments.src: - **What does it do for everyone else?** Construction, electrical work, and energy demand may benefit locally, but the broader effect on jobs and household income is harder to measure and still being studied.
segments.tr: - **Qu'est-ce que cela fait pour tout le monde ?** La construction, le travail électrique et la demande d'énergie peuvent en bénéficier localement, mais l'effet plus large sur l'emploi et le revenu des ménages est plus difficile à mesurer et est toujours à l'étude.

segments.src: None of this means the expansion is fragile or that the spending is misplaced.
segments.tr: Rien de tout cela ne signifie que l'expansion est fragile ou que les dépenses sont mal placées.

segments.src: It means the composition of growth matters as much as the headline.
segments.tr: Cela signifie que la composition de la croissance compte autant que le titre.

segments.src: ## What to Watch on Sept. 30
segments.tr: ## Ce qu'il faut surveiller le 30 septembre

segments.src: Two data releases due on Sept.
segments.tr: Deux publications de données prévues le 30

segments.src: 30 could sharpen the picture:
segments.tr: septembre pourraient affiner l'image :

segments.src: 1. **The revision to second-quarter GDP.** The 1.5% figure for Q2 is the base against which the third-quarter rebound is being measured. A revision up or down would change how large the swing looks.
segments.tr: 1. **La révision du PIB du deuxième trimestre.** Le chiffre de 1,5 % pour le T2 est la base par rapport à laquelle le rebond du troisième trimestre est mesuré. Une révision à la hausse ou à la baisse modifierait l'ampleur de la variation.

segments.src: 2. **August PCE inflation.** The PCE index is the inflation gauge the Federal Reserve tracks most closely. Whether the July pace of 3.7% eases, holds, or picks up will matter for household sentiment and for expectations about interest rates. It is also worth checking whether a given figure is the headline or the "core" measure (which excludes food and energy), and whether it is a monthly or annual change, since they can tell different stories.
segments.tr: 2. **L'inflation PCE d'août.** L'indice PCE est la jauge d'inflation que la Réserve fédérale suit de près. Que le rythme de juillet de 3,7 % diminue, se maintienne ou reparte à la hausse comptera pour le moral des ménages et pour les anticipations concernant les taux d'intérêt. Il vaut également la peine de vérifier si un chiffre donné est la mesure globale ou "de base" (qui exclut l'alimentation et l'énergie), et s'il s'agit d'une variation mensuelle ou annuelle, car elles peuvent raconter des histoires différentes.

segments.src: The first official estimate of third-quarter GDP will come only after the quarter ends, so the tracker's number will continue to shift as new data arrive.
segments.tr: La première estimation officielle du PIB du troisième trimestre n'interviendra qu'après la fin du trimestre, de sorte que le chiffre de l'indicateur continuera d'évoluer à mesure que de nouvelles données arriveront.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## L'essentiel

segments.src: A strong growth estimate and a gloomy public mood are not necessarily a contradiction.
segments.tr: Une forte estimation de la croissance et une humeur publique morose ne sont pas nécessairement une contradiction.

segments.src: GDP measures the total value of what the economy produces, while sentiment reflects how people experience prices, borrowing costs, and job prospects in daily life.
segments.tr: Le PIB mesure la valeur totale de ce que l'économie produit, tandis que le sentiment reflète la façon dont les gens vivent les prix, les coûts d'emprunt et les perspectives d'emploi dans la vie quotidienne.

segments.src: When growth leans on business investment, particularly in a single fast-moving area such as AI infrastructure, the gap between the statistics and the lived experience can widen.
segments.tr: Lorsque la croissance s'appuie sur l'investissement des entreprises, en particulier dans un seul domaine en évolution rapide tel que l'infrastructure d'IA, l'écart entre les statistiques et l'expérience vécue peut se creuser.

segments.src: For readers trying to make sense of the data, a few habits help: look at several indicators rather than one, distinguish between estimates and official releases, and pay attention to what is driving a number rather than only how large it is.
segments.tr: Pour les lecteurs qui essaient de donner un sens aux données, quelques habitudes aident : regarder plusieurs indicateurs plutôt qu'un seul, faire la distinction entre les estimations et les publications officielles, et prêter attention à ce qui motive un chiffre plutôt qu'à son seul volume.

segments.tr: Pesquisas sobre padrões de consumo frequentemente descobriram que uma grande parcela do gasto total vem de famílias de renda mais alta, enquanto famílias de baixa e média renda podem sentir mais pressão dos custos diários.

segments.src: An investment boom is not the same as a paycheck boom.** Spending on buildings, equipment, and technology adds to GDP right away.
segments.tr: Um boom de investimentos não é o mesmo que um boom salarial.** Gastos com edifícios, equipamentos e tecnologia aumentam o PIB imediatamente.

segments.src: But it does not automatically translate into higher wages, lower borrowing costs, or cheaper essentials for the average household.
segments.tr: Mas isso não se traduz automaticamente em salários mais altos, custos de empréstimos mais baixos ou produtos essenciais mais baratos para a família média.

segments.src: ## The AI Data-Center Question
segments.tr: ## A Questão dos Data-Centers de IA

segments.src: The most debated part of the story is how much of the investment surge is tied to the buildout of artificial-intelligence infrastructure: data-center construction, servers and chips, networking gear, and the power and cooling systems that support them.
segments.tr: A parte mais debatida da história é quanto da onda de investimentos está vinculada à construção de infraestrutura de inteligência artificial: construção de data-centers, servidores e chips, equipamentos de rede e os sistemas de energia e resfriamento que os suportam.

segments.src: These outlays are counted as business investment, and when they accelerate, they can lift the headline growth figure noticeably.
segments.tr: Esses gastos são contabilizados como investimento empresarial e, quando aceleram, podem elevar visivelmente o valor do crescimento principal.

segments.src: That raises a few questions economists are weighing:
segments.tr: Isso levanta algumas questões que os economistas estão ponderando:

segments.src: - **How much is imported?** Much of the advanced hardware is produced abroad. In GDP accounting, imports are subtracted, so a surge in spending on imported equipment does not add as much to domestic output as the investment figure alone might suggest.
segments.tr: - **Quanto é importado?** Muito do hardware avançado é produzido no exterior. Na contabilidade do PIB, as importações são subtraídas, então um aumento nos gastos com equipamentos importados não adiciona tanto à produção doméstica quanto o valor do investimento sozinho poderia sugerir.

segments.src: - **How concentrated is it?** If a relatively small number of large companies account for a large share of the spending, changes in their plans could reverse the contribution quickly.
segments.tr: - **Quão concentrado é?** Se um número relativamente pequeno de grandes empresas responde por uma grande parcela dos gastos, mudanças em seus planos podem reverter a contribuição rapidamente.

segments.src: - **How durable is it?** Investment is inherently lumpy. A strong quarter does not guarantee the next one, and the payoff from these projects, in productivity and profits, will take time to become clear.
segments.tr: - **Quão durável é?** O investimento é inerentemente instável. Um trimestre forte não garante o próximo, e o retorno desses projetos, em produtividade e lucros, levará tempo para ficar claro.

segments.src: - **What does it do for everyone else?** Construction, electrical work, and energy demand may benefit locally, but the broader effect on jobs and household income is harder to measure and still being studied.
segments.tr: - **O que isso faz por todo o resto?** Construção, trabalho elétrico e demanda de energia podem se beneficiar localmente, mas o efeito mais amplo sobre empregos e renda familiar é mais difícil de medir e ainda está sendo estudado.

segments.src: None of this means the expansion is fragile or that the spending is misplaced.
segments.tr: Nada disso significa que a expansão seja frágil ou que os gastos estejam mal direcionados.

segments.src: It means the composition of growth matters as much as the headline.
segments.tr: Significa que a composição do crescimento importa tanto quanto a manchete.

segments.src: ## What to Watch on Sept. 30
segments.tr: ## O Que Observar em 30 de Setembro

segments.src: Two data releases due on Sept.
segments.tr: Duas divulgações de dados previstas para 30 de

segments.src: 30 could sharpen the picture:
segments.tr: setembro podem tornar o cenário mais nítido:

segments.src: 1. **The revision to second-quarter GDP.** The 1.5% figure for Q2 is the base against which the third-quarter rebound is being measured. A revision up or down would change how large the swing looks.
segments.tr: 1. **A revisão do PIB do segundo trimestre.** O valor de 1.5% para o Q2 é a base em relação à qual a recuperação do terceiro trimestre está sendo medida. Uma revisão para cima ou para baixo mudaria a aparência da oscilação.

segments.src: 2. **August PCE inflation.** The PCE index is the inflation gauge the Federal Reserve tracks most closely. Whether the July pace of 3.7% eases, holds, or picks up will matter for household sentiment and for expectations about interest rates. It is also worth checking whether a given figure is the headline or the "core" measure (which excludes food and energy), and whether it is a monthly or annual change, since they can tell different stories.
segments.tr: 2. **A inflação do PCE de agosto.** O índice PCE é o indicador de inflação que a Reserva Federal acompanha mais de perto. Se o ritmo de julho de 3.7% vai se abrandar, se manter ou acelerar, será importante para o sentimento das famílias e para as expectativas sobre as taxas de juros. Também vale a pena verificar se um determinado valor é a medida geral ou "núcleo" (que exclui alimentos e energia), e se é uma variação mensal ou anual, pois elas podem contar histórias diferentes.

segments.src: The first official estimate of third-quarter GDP will come only after the quarter ends, so the tracker's number will continue to shift as new data arrive.
